page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 64 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 5.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs from the Ampere architecture, providing a combined 96 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, requiring external block storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong multi-threaded performance and high memory throughput. The multi-core stress-ng CPU benchmark places this instance in the top 25%, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaches top-tier status at 575.13 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 6856.96 GB/sec and large block uncached write speeds at 103.09 GB/sec. Single-core performance remains average, as shown by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded compression tests. Redis SET operations perform strongly at 100.72 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 61.52 GB/sec.

Given its high resource density, the instance offers a specialized hardware profile that balances massive parallel compute with dedicated GPU acceleration. The absence of local storage means users must factor in external storage costs, but the high-speed 64 Gbps network baseline mitigates potential bottlenecks. This configuration is highly suited for workloads such as deep learning inference, multi-stream video transcoding, high-performance computing, and large-scale parallel data processing.
